owner_ask: make the loading and models much smoother
baseline_tree: dc2545a (HEAD at round start; battle-ai r7 7v7 included)

diagnosis.method: per-idle-job telemetry (window.__GLB_JOBS, kind+ms per job) + rAF sampler across the player battle-entry path (tools/tmp-perfsmooth-swapprobe.mjs --player)
diagnosis.baseline_swap_job_ms: 38-359 per model (applySwap 26-188 + first-use warm 12-171 in ONE idle slot), landing through the staging window and into visible combat frames

1_swap_smoothness.fix: modelLoader applySwap split into prepareSwapStart / finishPrepareSwap / commitSwap; async path is a pipelined state machine (prep, camoShare xN, camoMerge, warmTex xN, compile, commit) with amortized GPU texture uploads (8 MB/slot), per-sheet camo composite warm (materials.warmNextGlbShare), program pre-compile against the live scene, and the model only becomes visible at commit — no half-textured or T-posed frame can render. Capture contexts (shot phase / paused session) drain all remaining stages in one slot (old monolith behavior, always safe there).

after_stage_costs_ms.camoShare_slice_max: 150 (one 512-1024 sheet composite; cached globally per source texture)

1_swap_smoothness.note: remaining visible-entry >25ms frames carry identical draw calls to neighbors (host-contention stalls, 18-core box shared with sibling agent harnesses)
scheduling_fixes_along_the_way: hot-lane predicate could never flag a single queued job (nextJobIndex returns an index) — the last tank's pipeline chained on the rIC 350 ms path
hot-lane needed the live scene BEFORE window.__DEBUG exists (main.js now publishes window.__COT_LIVE_SCENE at scene creation)

pipeline AFFINITY: hot stages of multiple boot heroes round-robined, so the pedestal hero's commit landed after the COMBINED work of all staged heroes (reveal 1.5 s -> 5.2 s after ready); sticky-tag selection restores monolith ordering (reveal 2.4 s headless worst-case, better than baseline when the player dwells on the boot splash — bounded 150 ms drain chunks run behind it)
the visible pre-battle loading screen counts as staging (battleScreenUp) so the sim clock cannot strand the drain

diagnosis: materials.applyCamoToModel cloned ONE MATERIAL PER MESH, defeating modelLoader.mergeStaticKit's material-instance buckets: swapped GLB tanks submitted 30-100 main-pass draws each (census: m1a2 115 unique material instances over 144 meshes, 51 param-classes)

PRE-EXISTING BUG: the commit-time castShadow-off sweep used absolute visibility from the tank root — tanks whose swap committed while HIDDEN (unspotted enemies, staged garage roster) kept per-mesh casters and cast 4-22 meshes x cascades once spotted (baseline census: jagdtiger 22, object279 7, is7/is6b 5). This, plus the merge defeat, is the r7 1024-worst-frame breach.
fix: applyCamoToModel clones one material per param-class (all render params + texture identities + skip-rule outcome in the key) — merge buckets group again; visual output identical by construction
mergeStaticKit moved into the detached prep phase with articulated-subtree exclusions (turret/gun/followers)
visibleMeshes made root-relative so the caster sweep and texture strip work on hidden tanks

swap-time buildShadowProxy deleted: it only re-merged the build-time procShadow_* proxies into identical copies (and leaked the merged geometry on eviction); commitSwap keeps the build proxies casting instead
2_draw_call_budget.budget: worst-frame 760 (dsf1) / 589 (dsf2) vs 900 budget (was 923-1024); triangles median 4.60M vs 7M gate and now under the 6M shadow-proxy-LOD ratchet target

changes: roster GLB fetches all kick at 56% (roster pick) instead of serializing behind ~13 sequential visual bakes
new bounded 'Loading vehicle models' stage (92-100%) holds the screen until no fielded tank has a pending swap (bar driven by real committed-model count; 8 s bound; instant when cached)
modelLoader treats the visible loading screen as staging (battleScreenUp) so the sim clock cannot expire the 6 s grace behind the screen and strand the drain

cold_world_entry_after_ms.note: final-code run (shots/perf-smooth-r1/swap-player-FINAL.json); drain completes inside its 8 s bound — all 10 GLB tanks committed behind the screen

battle_load.tradeoff: cold-entry wall time buys a hitch-free entry: swap work that used to land as 38-359 ms frames in the first playable seconds now drains behind the screen; visible-entry hitches 25-30 -> 5-13 frames per entry. Warm-world re-entries skip world+swapDrain almost entirely (both stages gate on cached state).

boot.stage_table: min-of-3 per-stage __BOOT_TIMINGS identical baseline vs after within noise (top: post 112/113, vehicle 110/113, imports 104/102 ms) — no boot-path change this round; evidence shots/perf-smooth-r1/boot-*.json

4_texture_headroom.fix: commitSwap nulls texture slots on materials used ONLY by the swept-hidden procedural stand-in (root-relative live-material set protects decor/kit/shared canvases); per-spec TEX_CACHE canvases stay cached for rebuilds/repaints
4_texture_headroom.census: scene textures 479.7 -> 427.9 MB in the matprobe methodology (-51.8), texture count 230 -> 186, programs 271 -> 241, geometries 422 -> 339
4_texture_headroom.gate: 512 MB frozen gate passes with ~78 MB headroom (was 15)

goals.5_sim_step: measurement + handoff only (see docs/perf-smooth-r1-simstep-handoff.md); no spotting/AI code touched

verification.selftests: movement 28, combat 233, spotting 99, equipment 166, track-geometry — all pass
verification.screenshot_contract: full 20-view run green, zero console errors; per-view pixel diff vs baseline worktree within the same-tree run-to-run noise floor (worst offender sniper_view 0.561% vs 0.563% floor); two capture races found during the round (procedural stand-in in player_view/sniper_view) fixed via capture-context pipeline drain and re-verified
verification.certification: 60 s dsf1/dsf2 runs recorded (docs/perf-smooth-r1-after-dsf*.json); both stamped contended (sibling interactive-browser GPU 26-57%) so certification is refused by the tool — quietcert launched, see docs/quietcert-r6.log; all counted metrics (draws, textures, triangles, casters) are contention-immune

files_changed: src/vehicles/modelLoader.js — swap pipeline split + scheduling (staging window, hot single-job fix, tiny-job cadence), prefetchGlb export, root-relative visibleMeshes, procedural-standin texture strip, __GLB_JOBS telemetry
src/vehicles/materials.js — applyCamoToModel param-class material dedup; warmNextGlbShare export
src/main.js — battle-load roster GLB prefetch + bounded swap-drain stage + __BATTLE_LOAD telemetry; __DEBUG.beginBattleEntry/enterGarage
deliberately_not_done: no state.js/ai.js changes (constraint): roster pre-pick before world build (would let GLB fetches overlap a COLD world build) needs a state.js seam — prefetch starts at 56% instead
no GLB texture-cap reductions for AI tanks (killcam closeup fidelity precedent)
no cross-variant texture content-hash dedup (camo share composites key per source texture; sharing across specs would collide per-spec pattern composites)
GLB_TINTED entries of evicted visuals still accumulate (pre-existing; restyle-only cost, not scene-reachable)
